questions.q: For a downward camera, how is the target offset in meters related to the error in the frame?
questions.explain: ≈ h·tan(e·FOV/2): that is why K_p "drifts" if the height is ignored.

questions.q: What limits the gain of a tracking loop?
questions.explain: The K_p limit is ≈ π/(2·T_d) in the ideal case, lower in practice.

questions.q: What happens in ArduPilot GUIDED if the setpoints stop arriving?
options: Lands where the link was lost
questions.explain: That is a safeguard; your own watchdog must fire earlier.

questions.q: What should happen when there has been no detection for 0.5 s?
Where should the loop take its commands from?
questions.explain: Otherwise there is a jerk on every detection.

questions.q: What must the companion do after the pilot takes over?
questions.explain: A mode switch on the transmitter has absolute priority.

questions.q: How do you account for target motion so as not to lag behind?
options: More P and a lower FPS
A low-pass filter on the error
questions.explain: P alone leaves a steady-state velocity error.

questions.q: Why does the detection watchdog send zero velocity and not the last command?
options: The last command takes the vehicle after the lost target
The companion has no access to the last command
questions.explain: Without a target, the safe action is to stop and hover.
